Oil Pressure Sender for individual Dakota Digital Gauges


From Dakota Digital

Pressure Senders for use with standalone Dakota Digital gauges.

SEN-03-1 (dual terminal connection)
Thread: 1/8" NPT
Range: 0 - 150 psi

SEN-10-2 / 150011 (single terminal connection)
Thread: 1/8" NPT
Range: 0 - 75 psi

SEN-03-3 (single terminal connection)
Thread: M10 x1
Range: 0 - 150 psi

SEN-03-5 (dual terminal connection)
Thread: 1/8" NPT
Range: 0 - 300 psi

Oil Pressure sensors used in Dakota Digital complete instrument systems (with a Control Module) vary from the list above.  To locate a replacement oil pressure sensor, visit the Replacement Parts category:  Replacement Parts
 

SEN-03-6
Metric bushing package is CNC Machined from high quality brass stock.  Aluminum crush washers included to ensure a proper seal.  All bushings convert 1/8" NPT Male sensors to the following metric sizes:

  • 10mm x 1.5 (will accommodate Pressure sensors)
  • 12mm x 1.5 (will accommodate Pressure and Dakota Digital 2-wire Temperature sensors)
  • 14mm x 1.5 (will accommodate both Pressure and Temperature sensors)
  • 16mm x 1.5 (will accommodate both Pressure and Temperature sensors)
  • 1/8"-28 BSP (will accommodate Pressure sensors)
